detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX — Production data in testing is still common, and Tricentis CI [GENERIC CVE]
id: apex-generic-5e17d3d4
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects exploitation activity for CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS. Vulnerability class: GENERIC_CVE. Tune detection fields for your specific environment and affected product versions.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/17
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1059
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  cve_exploitation_pivot:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS'
  post_exploitation_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'curl '
      - 'wget '
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'bitsadmin'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'exploit'
      - 'payload'
      - '/tmp/'
      - 'C:\\Temp\\'
  condition: cve_exploitation_pivot or post_exploitation_download
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity on affected systems
  - Security scanning tools (Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7)
  - Authorized penetration testing
level: medium
detection_pack.spl:
| comment "Production data in testing is still common, and Tricentis CI | CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS | APEX v184.0"

index=network OR index=proxy earliest=-24h
| eval threat_match = if(match(_raw, "(?i)(CDB\-ADVISORY\-PRODUCTION\-DATA\-IN\-TESTING\-IS)"), 1, 0)
| where threat_match=1
| eval rule="APEX-CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS", severity="HIGH"
| stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip, dest_host, rule, severity
| convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort -count
detection_pack.yara:

    meta:
        description   = "APEX detection: Production data in testing is still common, and Tricentis CISO wants i"
        cve           = "CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS"
        vuln_class    = "GENERIC_CVE"
        author        = "CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0"
        date          = "2026-10-17"
        reference     = "https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com"
        severity      = "high"

        $cve_ref = "CDB-ADVISORY-PRODUCTION-DATA-IN-TESTING-IS" ascii wide nocase  // CVE reference — narrow with observed payload
    condition:
        2 of them
}

detection_pack.qradar_aql:
/* QRadar AQL: Production data in testing is still common, and Tricentis CI | intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1 */
SELECT DATEFORMAT(devicetime,'YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EventTime,
  sourceip, destinationip, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS Source,

retro_hunt.spl_splunk:
| comment "RETRO-HUNT: intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1 | Production data in testing is still common, and Tricentis CI | Techniques: T1190 T1059"
index=* earliest=-90d latest=now
(
    ("<ip_indicator>")
    OR ("<domain_indicator>")
    OR ("<hash_indicator>")
)
| eval hunt_advisory="intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1"
| eval hunt_techniques="T1190 T1059"
| eval hunt_ts=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
| eval indicator_type=case(
    match(_raw, "(x.x.x.x"), "IP",
    match(_raw, "(domain"), "Domain",
    match(_raw, "(hash"), "Hash",
    1==1, "Unknown"
  )
| stats count AS hits,
    min(_time) AS first_seen,
    max(_time) AS last_seen,
    dc(host) AS affected_hosts,
    values(sourcetype) AS sources
    BY hunt_advisory, indicator_type, host
| where hits > 0
| eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
       last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
| sort - hits
retro_hunt.qradar_aql:
/* RETRO-HUNT AQL: intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1 | Lookback: 90d */
SELECT
    DATEFORMAT(devicetime,'YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EventTime,
    sourceip, destinationip, destinationhostname,
    username, "Application", "Event Category",
    LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) AS LogSource,
    QIDNAME(qid) AS EventName,
    'intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1' AS HuntAdvisoryID
FROM events
WHERE (
    destinationip IN ('<ip>')
    OR sourceip IN ('<ip>')
    OR destinationhostname IN ('<domain>')
    OR LOOKUPHOSTNAME(destinationip) IN ('<domain>')
)
AND devicetime > (NOW() - 7776000)
ORDER BY devicetime DESC
LIMIT 10000
START '90d ago'
STOP 'now'
retro_hunt.crowdstrike_eql:
/* RETRO-HUNT CrowdStrike Event Query: intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1 | Techniques: T1190, T1059 */
#type=ProcessRollup2 | head 1000
| eval hunt_id="intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1"
| search (sha256 = "<hash>") OR (DomainName = "<domain>")
| stats count by HostName, FileName, CommandLine, UserSid, TimeStamp
| sort count desc
retro_hunt.generic_sql:
/* RETRO-HUNT Generic SQL: intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1 | Lookback: 90d */
/* Compatible with: Splunk Data Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Data Explorer */
SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    host_name,
    source_ip,
    destination_ip,
    destination_domain,
    file_hash_sha256,
    process_name,
    process_command_line,
    user_name,
    'intel--48eb3ec8cd921cd1' AS hunt_advisory_id
FROM security_events
WHERE event_timestamp > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND (
    destination_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR source_ip IN ('<ip>')
    OR destination_domain IN ('<domain>')
    OR file_hash_sha256 IN ('<hash>')
  )
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50000;
